# CineMatch — Movie Discovery App
# https://your-domain.vercel.app

CineMatch is a movie discovery and social platform built with React, TypeScript, Firebase Authentication, Supabase, and the TMDB API.

## Features
- Browse trending, popular, and latest movie releases
- Build and manage a personal watchlist
- Write and read community movie reviews
- AI-powered movie recommendations via Google Gemini
- User profiles and social following

## Tech
- Frontend: React 19, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS
- Backend: Node.js, Express
- Auth: Firebase Authentication
- Database: Supabase (PostgreSQL)
- Movie Data: TMDB API
